caption:
Unpopular opinion: nobody remembers signing up for half their subscriptions. 😅

A streaming app here, a free trial there, a 'premium' upgrade you forgot about.

Small charges add up fast, and they never ask permission to renew.

When did you last check what's quietly leaving your account every month?
first_comment: Be honest: how many subscriptions do you have right now? 👇

instagram.first_comment: Drop your number of subscriptions below. Tag a friend who needs an audit 😅 @paychecktruths
